premise: A planetary council is conducting a long-horizon policy exercise. It must manage governance, population, ecology, resources, energy, technology, and observable consequences without assuming that technical capacity alone decides the outcome.

agents.name: Governance Steward
agents.goal: Propose institutions and constraints while identifying whose agency and freedoms are affected.

agents.name: Resource Steward
agents.goal: Track material and energy constraints and reject unsupported claims of unlimited resources.

agents.name: Ecology Steward
agents.goal: Protect biosphere integrity and surface tradeoffs that other council members omit.

agents.name: Technology Steward
agents.goal: Explore technical options without treating technology as inevitable or uniformly beneficial.

agents.name: Population Steward
agents.goal: Examine demographic consequences and state uncertainty instead of inventing precise quantities.

agents.name: Observer Steward
agents.goal: Track potential technosignatures and never equate non-detection with absence of technology.
